problem: Background sync shared the busy flag with reading and disabled every mail row. Its finally handler could also release a pending read guard.
fix: Sync uses checking only, read retains busy. Repeated sync remains suppressed; cached reading stays available; selected body and closed panel are preserved.

authorization_probe.scope: read-only metadata, no credential values or message bodies

verification.browser_transport: Synthetic deferred promises; actual component and browser. No real mailbox writes or remote model calls.
verification.baseline: Old component fails the row-enabled assertion while sync is pending; original failure retained locally.
